description: The bar chart, titled "Recall@10," displays the performance of different methods in a conversation recommendation system, with the y-axis representing the Recall@10 metric on a scale from 0.1 to 0.4. The x-axis lists four methods: "Ours," "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking." The bar for "Ours" is the tallest, reaching a value of approximately 0.35. The bar for "- critiquing" is the second tallest, at approximately 0.29. The bar for "- ranking" is the third tallest, at approximately 0.24. The bar for "- scoring" is the shortest, at approximately 0.17. The chart uses a distinct color for each method: "Ours" is represented by a gold-colored bar, while the other three methods are represented by dark blue bars.
